  • Stay ahead of emerging trends in AI/ML, evaluating new research, frameworks, and tools to enhance product capabilities.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers, guiding best practices throughout the ML lifecycle.


Minimum Qualifications

  • Advanced written and oral English proficiency.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, or a related field.
  • 7+ years of professional experience designing, building, and deploying machine learning models in production environments.
  • Strong hands-on experience with AWS for ML workflows (data pipelines, model training, deployment, and monitoring).
  • Expert proficiency in Python and ML frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, and scikit-learn.
  • Proficiency with TypeScript for building ML-integrated backend services and automation workflows.
  • Experience with Infrastructure-as-Code tools (Terraform, AWS CDK, or CloudFormation ) for deploying ML infrastructure.
  • Strong knowledge of data processing and analysis tools (Pandas, NumPy, SQL) and orchestration workflows.

  • Experience with containerization (Docker), orchestration (Kubernetes), and MLOps best practices.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with large language models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, or agentic AI systems.
  • Expertise in deep learning, NLP, time-series forecasting, or computer vision.
  • Familiarity with platforms such as MLflow, Kubeflow, or Amazon SageMaker for model lifecycle management.
  • Contributions to open-source AI/ML projects or publications in the field.
  • Understanding of data engineering workflows, ETL pipelines, and real-time data processing


Benefits

  • Yearly Office Allowance Budget

  • Wellbeing Support

title: Analista de Dados | Especialista em Tableau | Sustentação e Governança de Dados (DataOps)
description:
A BDA Solutions, empresa especializada em Data & AI, está contratando um Analista de Dados com especialização na gestão e sustentação do ambiente da plataforma Tableau , atuando com foco em governança, qualidade e continuidade operacional dos dados na modalidade de contratação: PJ.


O profissional será responsável por garantir a integridade, estabilidade e eficiência das operações analíticas, assegurando que os processos de carga, transformação e visualização de dados atendam aos padrões corporativos de desempenho e segurança.

Principais Atividades

  • Monitorar jobs, agendamentos e cargas de dados, verificando a integridade das conexões entre sistemas (ERP, Data Warehouse, BI).
  • Assegurar a execução correta dos processos ETL/ELT e a disponibilidade do ambiente Tableau.
  • Atender chamados técnicos, identificar falhas em dashboards e apoiar analistas de negócio na resolução de divergências de dados.
  • Investigar causas de erros ou quebras em relatórios, executar queries SQL e realizar auditorias de dados.
  • Administrar permissões de acesso em Tableau Server e BI corporativo, conforme políticas internas de segurança e compliance.
  • Manter documentação técnica de processos, integrações e fluxos de dados, garantindo rastreabilidade e transparência.
  • Implementar métricas e políticas de governança e qualidade de dados.


Responsabilidades

  • Garantir que o ambiente de dados permaneça estável, atualizado e seguro , minimizando falhas e indisponibilidades.
  • Apoiar áreas de negócio e demais times técnicos, assegurando performance e integrações estáveis entre sistemas (ERP, CRM, MES, etc.).
  • Corrigir inconsistências e documentar soluções, promovendo aprendizado contínuo e padronização de processos.
  • Cumprir requisitos de governança e segurança , garantindo controle de acessos e proteção de dados sensíveis.
  • Fornecer dados auditáveis e padronizados, suportando as políticas de governança corporativa e DataOps da organização.


Habilidades Técnicas Obrigatórias:

  • Experiência em ambientes Tableau Server / Tableau Cloud ;
  • Conhecimento em SQL , processos ETL/ELT e governança de dados ;
  • Familiaridade com integrações entre sistemas corporativos (ERP, CRM, MES, etc.) ;
  • Boa capacidade de documentação, análise e comunicação técnica.

title: Azure Platform Engineer/ Architect
description:
Role Overview :


We are is seeking a hands-on Azure Platform Engineer/Architect with strong architectural knowledge of Azure PaaS services and DevOps skills. This person will work closely with backend engineers and automation teams to design, implement, and deploy cloud-native solutions on Azure. The role requires expertise in Azure services, Infrastructure as Code, and CI/CD pipelines, with the ability to troubleshoot and support PaaS solutions end-to-end.

Key Responsibilities :

  • Collaborate with backend engineers to architect and deploy Azure PaaS solutions, including Azure Functions, App Services, AKS, ACR, APIM, and Application Gateway.
  • Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps (YAML-based pipelines) or GitHub Actions when required.
  • Develop Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates, with the ability to deploy infrastructure manually if needed.
  • Provide hands-on troubleshooting of Azure environments, including debugging deployments, managing permissions (RBAC), and resolving issues with PaaS services.
  • Assist data scientists and AI engineers with containerization, API endpoints, and prototyping on Azure Machine Learning or related services.
  • Implement and enforce security gates (SonarQube, SCA, DAST, SAST) in CI/CD pipelines and ensure compliance with Azure policies and governance.
  • Optimize and monitor Azure environments using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and Application Insights.
  • Support and improve operational automation (PowerShell, Python) and cost optimization initiatives (tagging, right-sizing).
  • Collaborate with teams to build solutions that run entirely on Azure PaaS, ensuring performance and scalability.

Required Skills :

  • Strong experience with Azure Functions, App Services, AKS, ACR, and APIM.
  • Hands-on expertise with Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates.
  • Proficiency in Azure DevOps Services (Repos, Pipelines, Boards, Artifacts) and/or GitHub Actions.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills for Azure PaaS services and deployment issues.
  • Experience with blue-green, canary, and rolling deployment strategies.
  • Knowledge of security and compliance practices in Azure (Azure Policy, RBAC, Key Vault, Defender for Cloud).
  • Proficiency in PowerShell, Python, or Bash for automation.
  • Familiarity with Azure cost management and resource optimization.
  • Excellent communication skills to guide and support development and data science teams.

title: : Senior Software Engineer – Infrastructure
description:
About the job


At Avenue Code, we are passionate about transforming businesses through technology. We are a leading end-to-end development consultancy for digital transformation across various markets, growing sustainably since day one. We believe that great results are born from strong relationships. Our team combines technical expertise, collaboration, and a welcoming approach to work that makes all the difference.



About the Opportunity


We are seeking a Senior Engineer to join our high-performing engineering team, focused on building highly available, large-scale, and low-latency data platforms . This role is ideal for a hands-on, experienced engineer who can immediately contribute to solving complex challenges, driving technical excellence, and enhancing our DevOps and backend infrastructure.

You’ll join a collaborative, empowered, and agile team responsible for enterprise data distribution applications and backend APIs that serve external customers worldwide, including international markets such as Canada and Japan . This position offers the opportunity to take ownership of critical DevOps operations, design scalable solutions, and continuously evolve our platform’s reliability, performance, and security.


Responsibilities


  • Design, build, and maintain highly available and scalable backend systems and APIs.
  • Lead and own DevOps initiatives , including CI/CD pipeline management, cloud infrastructure, and container orchestration.
  • Implement and maintain infrastructure as code using Terraform , ensuring secure, reproducible, and automated deployments.
  • Work closely with stakeholders, product owners, and cross-functional teams to deliver new features and improve existing systems .
  • Ensure disaster recovery readiness and compliance with security best practices .
  • Manage and optimize AWS services (S3, RDS, EventBridge, SQS, IAM, VPC, ECR, etc.).
  • Deploy and manage Kubernetes (EKS) clusters and Docker images in production environments.
  • Troubleshoot complex issues across distributed systems and drive root cause analysis.
  • Maintain high standards of code quality, testing, and documentation .
  • Collaborate across engineering teams (Platform, Security, UX) to ensure seamless integration and delivery.


Required Qualifications


  • 8+ years of professional experience in functional programming , with Node.js / JavaScript (not TypeScript).
  • Proven experience with DevOps practices and cloud-native environments .
  • Deep hands-on experience with Kubernetes (EKS) and Docker .
  • Expertise with AWS (S3, RDS, EventBridge, SQS, DMS, Security Groups, IAM, VPCs, ECR).
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and experience with relational databases (MSSQL, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Aurora, RDS).
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment workflows.
  • Familiarity with Terraform (infrastructure as code).
  • Solid understanding of application security and use of security tools (e.g., Wiz, Snyk ).
  • Strong debugging, issue resolution, and troubleshooting skills.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively in an agile environment.
  • Pragmatic mindset with a strong sense of ownership and craftsmanship .


Nice to Have Skills


  • Experience with automated database migrations and versioning.
  • Background in API integration and distribution systems .
  • Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana).
  • Exposure to multi-region cloud deployments .
  • Previous experience supporting regulated industries or compliance-driven environments.
  • Passion for mentoring team members and driving engineering best practices.



Avenue Code ensures the privacy of all candidates in compliance with regulations such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA, and CPRA. The data will be used solely for recruitment processes and may be shared, in a limited manner, with clients and CompassUOL Group companies when necessary to provide services.

title: Bolsista Graduado - Grupo Boticário - UX - Produtos Digitais da Indústria | Talento Inovação -IEL/PR
description:
O Programa Talento Inovação do IEL Paraná tem como foco selecionar, acompanhar e desenvolver bolsistas, além de coordenar ações com organizações parceiras. Ele convida indústrias a proporem projetos de Pesquisa, Desenvolvimento e Inovação (PD&I ) nos quais a participação dos bolsistas promova o crescimento profissional em PD&I empresarial e contribua para a inovação da empresa.

O programa oferece bolsas para graduandos, graduados, mestres e doutores, permitindo atividades de PD&I nas instalações das empresas pelo território nacional, após aprovação da Comissão Interna do IEL Paraná.


Projeto: UX - Produtos Digitais da Indústria


Sobre a Oportunidade:


Inovação e desenvolvimento são parte do DNA do Grupo Boticário, e você pode fazer parte de evolução. Estamos em busca de um talento colaborativo e analítico para atuar na criação de um sistema inédito de governança e acompanhamento dos programas de Desenvolvimento e Capacitação Industrial.

O projeto visa centralizar informações, automatizar processos e otimizar a alocação de mão de obra, trazendo mais eficiência, agilidade e inteligência à gestão fabril.

Se você quer contribuir com soluções que conectam tecnologia, pessoas e resultados, essa oportunidade é para você.


Formação Acadêmica: Design ou áreas correlatas


Principais Atividades:

  • Desenvolver interfaces e fluxos de usuário intuitivos e eficazes, seguindo as melhores práticas de UX e os padrões de design do Grupo Boticário;
  • Colaborar com designers de produto e engenheiros na adoção, uso e documentação dos componentes;
  • Prototipar e conduzir testes de usabilidade para validar as soluções de design e aprimorar a experiência do usuário;
  • Colaborar com a equipe de desenvolvimento, garantindo a implementação adequada e a consistência visual das interfaces;
  • Produzir e manter a documentação de design, incluindo guias de estilo e especificações técnicas;
  • Apresentar soluções de design e coletar feedback de stakeholders para promover melhorias contínuas



Conhecimentos Necessários:

  • Formação em Design ou áreas correlatas, com experiência em UX para aplicações web ou mobile;
  • Domínio de ferramentas de design como Figma ou similares;
  • Habilidades de comunicação;
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais;
  • Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções de produto;
  • Facilidade para atuar em ambientes multifuncionais, multilíngues e colaborativos, com autonomia;
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis e trabalho em squads multidisciplinares;
  • Conhecimento sólido em princípios de design de interação, usabilidade e acessibilidade.
  • Conhecimento sobre Product Designer, aplicando conceitos de Arquitetura de Informação, Visual, UX Writing, Pesquisa qualitativa e quantitativa, além de métodos de facilitação;


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência em pesquisa com usuários e testes de usabilidade;
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis;
  • Conhecimento básico de React.


Soft Skills:

  • Proatividade e iniciativa para resolver problemas e buscar soluções inovadoras.
  • Visão sistêmica e multidisciplinar para integrar aspectos técnicos e de negócio.
  • Facilidade para trabalhar em equipe e engajar diversos perfis profissionais.
  • Orientação a resultados, com foco em qualidade e prazos.



Valor da bolsa (mensal) : Bolsista (Graduado) R$1.500,00

Formato de trabalho : Remoto

Local: São José dos Pinhais – PR

title: English Language Specialist
description:
iMerit seeks detail-oriented and analytically minded Multimodal GenAI Evaluation Analysts to perform highly nuanced evaluations of AI system outputs across different modalities: text, image, video, and multimodal interactions. Analysts will assess the accuracy, appropriateness, quality, clarity, and cultural alignment of model outputs against complex guidelines, ensuring that results align with project standards and real-world use cases. These evaluations will directly inform the development and fine-tuning of advanced large language models (LLMs), vision models (LVMs), and multimodal AI systems.


Role Responsibilities:

  • Evaluate outputs generated by LLMs across multiple modalities (text, image captions, video descriptions, and multimodal prompts).
  • Assess quality against project-specific criteria such as correctness, coherence, completeness, style, cultural appropriateness, and safety.
  • Identify subtle errors, hallucinations, or biases in AI responses.
  • Apply domain expertise and logical reasoning to resolve ambiguous or unclear outputs.
  • Provide detailed written feedback, tagging, and scoring of outputs to ensure consistency across the evaluation team.
  • Escalate unclear cases and contribute to refining evaluation guidelines.
  • Collaborate with Project Managers and Quality Leads to meet accuracy, reliability, and turnaround benchmarks.


Skills & Competencies:

  • Strong critical reading, observational, and evaluative skills across different modalities.
  • Ability to articulate nuanced judgments with precision and clarity.
  • Excellent English comprehension (CEFR B2 or above); additional languages a plus.
  • Familiarity with LLMs, generative AI, and multimodal systems.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to apply guidelines consistently.
  • Awareness of cultural and linguistic nuances, including potential bias and harm in AI outputs.
  • Comfort with evolving workflows, rapid feedback cycles, and complex quality frameworks.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree/ diploma or equivalent educational qualification.
  • 1+ years of experience in data annotation, LLM evaluation, content moderation, or related AI/ML domains.
  • Demonstrated experience working with data annotation tools and software platforms.
  • Strong understanding of language and multimodal communication (instruction following in image generation, fact-checking, narrative coherence in video, etc.).
  • Ability to adapt quickly to changing project directions and fast-paced work environments.
  • Previous experience creating or annotating complex data specifically for Large Language Model (LLM) training.
  • Prior exposure to generative AI, prompt engineering, or LLM fine-tuning workflows is a plus.

While moderation of high-harm/high-risk material is not part of this role, candidates should be aware that occasional exposure to NSFW or otherwise sensitive content may occur due to imperfections in client-provided datasets. Applicants should indicate that they are comfortable working in environments where such incidental exposure is a possibility.


What We Offer:

  • Opportunities to shape the evaluation standards for next-generation multimodal AI systems.
  • Innovative and supportive global working environment.
  • Competitive compensation and flexible remote working arrangements.
  • Continuous learning and growth in applied AI evaluation.

Join iMerit to help shape the benchmarks and standards that ensure AI systems are accurate, safe, and culturally aware across text, vision, and multimodal applications. If rigorous analysis and innovation excite you, we encourage you to apply!

title: UX Designer – Food Delivery Operations
description:
Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home


Job Summary

As a UX Designer, you will be focused on designing and evolving digital products that optimize kitchen operations, inventory management, and location handling for multiple stakeholders. You will work across mobile, large screens, and web platforms, contributing from ideation to post-release improvements, always keeping usability and efficiency at the center of your work.


Responsibilities and Duties

  • Deeply analyze business problems and user needs to identify pain points and propose user-centered solutions;
  • Think strategically about the product experience, connecting the dots between business goals and user needs;
  • Collaborate with stakeholders, Product Managers, and Developers to clarify requirements and define acceptance criteria;
  • Create wireframes, prototypes, and user flows to validate ideas quickly;
  • Deliver high-fidelity mockups with all necessary states, edge cases, and error handling for smooth implementation;
  • Conduct benchmarking of industry patterns, features, and interaction behaviors to maintain product competitiveness;
  • Contribute to and maintain the UI kit and design system, ensuring scalability and visual consistency;
  • Own the design process end-to-end, from ideation to QA and post-release iterations;
  • Present your work, articulate your design decisions, and provide clear documentation;
  • Manage your time effectively and work proactively to keep projects moving forward.


Essential Skills

  • Experience designing end-to-end digital products for web, mobile, and large-screen applications;
  • Strong experience in B2B UX for complex operational or internal tools;
  • Proficiency in Figma, FigJam, and collaborative design workflows;
  • Experience leveraging AI tools such as Figma Make, Perplexity, and Vercel to streamline and speed up design work;
  • Strong knowledge and practice in both UX and UI design;
  • Experience working in fast-paced environments or startups;
  • Strong collaboration skills and ability to work closely with cross-functional teams in Agile environments;
  • Knowledge of food industry operations, kitchens, and inventory management processes is a plus.



About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.



At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home


Job Summary

As a UX Designer, you will be focused on designing and evolving digital products that optimize kitchen operations, inventory management, and location handling for multiple stakeholders. You will work across mobile, large screens, and web platforms, contributing from ideation to post-release improvements, always keeping usability and efficiency at the center of your work.


Responsibilities and Duties

  • Deeply analyze business problems and user needs to identify pain points and propose user-centered solutions;
  • Think strategically about the product experience, connecting the dots between business goals and user needs;
  • Collaborate with stakeholders, Product Managers, and Developers to clarify requirements and define acceptance criteria;
  • Create wireframes, prototypes, and user flows to validate ideas quickly;
  • Deliver high-fidelity mockups with all necessary states, edge cases, and error handling for smooth implementation;
  • Conduct benchmarking of industry patterns, features, and interaction behaviors to maintain product competitiveness;
  • Contribute to and maintain the UI kit and design system, ensuring scalability and visual consistency;
  • Own the design process end-to-end, from ideation to QA and post-release iterations;
  • Present your work, articulate your design decisions, and provide clear documentation;
  • Manage your time effectively and work proactively to keep projects moving forward.


Essential Skills

  • Experience designing end-to-end digital products for web, mobile, and large-screen applications;
  • Strong experience in B2B UX for complex operational or internal tools;
  • Proficiency in Figma, FigJam, and collaborative design workflows;
  • Experience leveraging AI tools such as Figma Make, Perplexity, and Vercel to streamline and speed up design work;
  • Strong knowledge and practice in both UX and UI design;
  • Experience working in fast-paced environments or startups;
  • Strong collaboration skills and ability to work closely with cross-functional teams in Agile environments;
  • Knowledge of food industry operations, kitchens, and inventory management processes is a plus.



About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.



At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Account Manager, Enterprise Browser
description:

At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission:

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Description

Your Career

You will join an exciting and high growth business unit with Palo Alto Networks positioning the industry’s most comprehensive SASE security platform, with the industry’s broadest security and compliance coverage for applications used by your hybrid workforce, regardless of whether they are at home, on the go, or in the office.

In this role, you will be responsible for managing a territory focusing on Major, Strategic, and Enterprise Accounts. Working closely with Palo Alto business partners and driving sales for our Enterprise Browser security solution, into new and existing customers. It is expected that you deliver or exceed your sales targets in both new business and renewals for ACV and TCV bookings.   • Keep up-to-date knowledge of Enterprise Browser and other browser technologies as well as the competitive position of the company
  • Conduct consistent training and communications for the sales and channel teams as well as joint engagement within the wider organization
  • Contribute to the larger Palo Alto Network’s Prisma SASE strategy by providing regional specific intelligence and reporting
  • Apply subject matter expertise in training, QBRs, enablement, and other engagement activities
  • Gather “Voice of Customer” and competitive intelligence and share with theater and global Prisma SASE organization
  • Help build and project Palo Alto Networks position
Qualifications

  • 4+ years' experience exceeding sales quota as Account Manager, or Territory Account Manager for a multinational company
  • Sales excellence - ability to demonstrate planning, strategy, qualification and execution
  • Prior experience selling SAAS or Cybersecurity network solutions
  • Existing relationships within the region, including top accounts and reseller partners
  • Excellent communication skills including strong verbal and written skills and proven presentation skills being able to articulate complex topics
  • Experience with target account selling, solution selling, and consultative sales techniques
Additional Information

The Team

Palo Alto Networks has brought technology to the market that is reshaping the cybersecurity threat and protection landscape. Our ability to protect digital transactions is limited only by our ability to establish relationships with our potential customers and help them understand how our products can protect their environments. This is where our sales teams come in. Our sales team members work together with large organizations to keep their digital information safe. Our passionate sales teams educate, inspire, and empower our potential clients.

As part of our sales team, you are empowered with unmatched systems and tools, constantly updated research and sales libraries, and a team built on joint success. You won’t find someone at Palo Alto Networks that isn’t committed to your success – with everyone pitching in to assist when it comes to solutions selling, learning, and development. As a member of our sales team, you are driven by a solutions-focused sales environment and find fulfillment in working with clients to resolve incredibly complex cyberthreats. You’re an amazing salesperson – you’re just looking for something more substantial and challenging as your next step.

Our Commitment

We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

title: Technical Sourcing Specialist
description:
We are looking for a remote Technical Sourcing Specialist based in Latin America with 3+ years of experience and excellent English communication skills — both written and spoken.

You’ll be responsible for identifying, engaging, and connecting top technical talent — including software engineers, developers, and other IT professionals — through platforms like LinkedIn Recruiter and other sourcing channels.

At Velozient, we’re a fast-moving, growth-stage company that values smart, proactive people who love connecting with others and enjoy the challenge of finding the best talent. You’ll play a key role in building and nurturing a high-quality pipeline that drives our hiring success.


Responsibilities

  • Proactively source, identify, and engage technical candidates through LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, social media, referrals, and other creative sourcing channels.
  • Build and maintain a robust pipeline of qualified candidates for current and future technical roles.
  • Partner closely with Recruiters and Resource Managers to deeply understand technical requirements and deliver high-quality leads.
  • Conduct initial outreach and screening conversations to assess technical fit, interest level, and alignment with open positions.
  • Develop targeted search strategies using advanced Boolean logic, filters, and data mining techniques.
  • Track sourcing activity and candidate engagement using internal systems and tools.
  • Stay up to date on market trends, technologies, and sourcing innovations to improve talent pipelines continuously.
  • Represent Velozient’s brand professionally and enthusiastically in all candidate interactions.
  • Support diversity sourcing initiatives and help drive inclusive hiring practices.


REQUIRED Experience:

  • Excellent English skills — both written and verbal.
  • Minimum of 3+ years of experience in candidate sourcing or talent acquisition, with a focus on technical roles (e.g., software engineering, IT, data, or product).
  • Proven experience using LinkedIn Recruiter and other sourcing tools.
  • Strong understanding of Boolean search, technical keyword targeting, and sourcing best practices.
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.


Preferred Experience:

  • University degree.
  • Prior experience sourcing for North American-based companies.
  • Experience in a growth-stage or entrepreneurial organization.


What YOU Get!

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company and work with innovative and creative people
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture - share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - Think big!
  • Making mistakes is human - let’s learn from them -be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual - no presumptions or judgment
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), designated national holidays, three sick leave days, and one floating day annually

title: Technical Sourcing Specialist
description:
We are looking for a remote Technical Sourcing Specialist based in Latin America with 3+ years of experience and excellent English communication skills — both written and spoken.

You’ll be responsible for identifying, engaging, and connecting top technical talent — including software engineers, developers, and other IT professionals — through platforms like LinkedIn Recruiter and other sourcing channels.

At Velozient, we’re a fast-moving, growth-stage company that values smart, proactive people who love connecting with others and enjoy the challenge of finding the best talent. You’ll play a key role in building and nurturing a high-quality pipeline that drives our hiring success.


Responsibilities

  • Proactively source, identify, and engage technical candidates through LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, social media, referrals, and other creative sourcing channels.
  • Build and maintain a robust pipeline of qualified candidates for current and future technical roles.
  • Partner closely with Recruiters and Resource Managers to deeply understand technical requirements and deliver high-quality leads.
  • Conduct initial outreach and screening conversations to assess technical fit, interest level, and alignment with open positions.
  • Develop targeted search strategies using advanced Boolean logic, filters, and data mining techniques.

  • Strong understanding of Boolean search, technical keyword targeting, and sourcing best practices.
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Golang)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Software Engineer with 8 to 12 years of software programming experience, including a strong background in Golang, Kubernetes, major cloud platforms, and CI/CD. You will fully automate provisioning, deployment, management, and monitoring for a rapidly evolving and highly scalable set of SaaS services. You will work with members of the DevOps team alongside a DevOps architect to ensure best practices are implemented across applications, lead teams in the direction of initiatives, such as CI/CD and enterprise monitoring, and work on support services operational on the cloud.

You are the ideal candidate if you enjoy improving engineering efficiency, mentoring junior team members, promoting best practices, and solving problems by digging into the technical details.

Our client was named a Top 25 Cybersecurity Company by The Software Report and one of Inc. Magazine's Best Places to Work in 2020. The company is a leader in cloud-based networking and security services. Their services empower organizations to optimize cloud usage, delivering network experiences that are simple, scalable, and reliable. The client counts 70% of the Fortune 500 companies as customers.


Responsibilities

  • Develop, design, and maintain features that empower developer productivity
  • Design and implement components of the client's next-generation, internal developer platform
  • Recommend ways to improve system reliability, efficiency, and quality
  • Work closely with various cross-functional product teams
  • Stay up-to-date on key trends, especially in the area of technologies and frameworks like Kubernetes, Docker, ELK/Prometheus, and more
  • Own platform engineering
  • Develop REST APIs and contribute to the overall API framework
  • Use multiple open software to build a developer platform


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 8 to 12 years of experience in software development using programming languages
  • Experience with Golang, including building API and web services
  • Experience with DevOps technologies and methodologies, including Kubernetes, major cloud platforms (preferably AWS), and CI/CD
  • Solid understanding of microservices architecture and container-based software, such as Docker
  • Experience developing microservices and using Cloud Services API
  • Strong focus on reliability and security
  • Solid exposure to application performance tuning, memory management, and scalability
  • Ability to design highly scalable distributed systems using different open-source technologies


Desired Experience

  • University degree or equivalent educational experience (preferably in a STEM field)
  • Additional container technologies besides Docker and Kubernetes
  • Experience with Amazon Web Services, such as EC2, VPC, ELB, S3, and CloudFormation, or equivalent services in GCP and/or Azure


Additional Info

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter – think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let’s learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual – no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!


Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!

description:
#OPORTUNIDADES para Engenheiro de dados / BI Developer a níveis Pleno e Sênior !

Projeto Internacional | Remoto LATAM (Fuso Alemanha)


Detalhes do Contrato

  • Modelo: PJ via Deel
  • INGLÊS FLUENTE NECESSÁRIO
  • Local: 100% remoto (América Latina)
  • Fuso: Horário da Alemanha (CET) !
  • Contrato de longa duração



A Stefanini LATAM está em busca de Desenvolvedor BI / Engenheiro de Dados com INGLÊS FLUENTE para atuar em um projeto global no setor de saúde , com duração prevista até meados de 2026.

O contrato será no modelo PJ/contractor (via Deel) e a atuação é 100% remota , com alinhamento ao fuso horário da Alemanha (CET) .

Buscamos profissionais na América Latina com sólida experiência em Dados e Business Intelligence, prontos para integrar um time técnico internacional de alta performance.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e manter soluções de BI utilizando Power BI , Tableau , SQL Server e Alteryx .
  • Colaborar com equipes de negócio globais para entender requisitos e transformá-los em dashboards e modelos de dados.
  • Otimizar processos de ETL e garantir a integridade e qualidade das informações.
  • Apoiar a migração de ETL legado para arquitetura AWS (prevista para 2026).
  • Integrar dados provenientes de SAP e outros sistemas corporativos.
  • Utilizar ferramentas Boomi para integração de dados.
  • Trabalhar em um POD técnico de 4 a 5 desenvolvedores , colaborando também com outras squads BI quando necessário.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada como Engenheiro de Dados, Desenvolvedor(a) BI ou cargo equivalente.
  • Experiência com integração de dados SAP .
  • Inglês avançado ou fluente (para comunicação com times globais).
  • Disponibilidade para atuar no fuso horário CET (Alemanha) .
  • Domínio de ferramentas: Power BI e Tableau; Alteryx; SQL Server; ETL; Plataforma Boomi; Talend; Databricks.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com serviços de dados em AWS .
  • Vivência em projetos do setor de saúde, medtech ou manufatura .
  • Atuação prévia em ambientes ágeis e times distribuídos internacionalmente .

title: Session Border Controller SR (100% remoto)
description:
Se você busca uma oportunidade na área de Tecnologia da Informação, tem organização, boa comunicação e vontade de crescer, essa vaga 100% remoto e CLT, pode ser para você.


Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Experiência sólida com Session Border Controller;
  • Experiência com Cisco, Mitel, Avaya, etc;
  • Experiência com Protocolos: SIP, RTP, TCP, UDP;
  • Idioma Inglês Avançado (terá inteirações internacionais).


Responsabilidades:

Como Session Border Controller Sênior, o profissional será responsável por projetar, configurar, implantar e manter soluções avançadas de SBC, garantindo comunicação de voz/vídeo segura, interoperável e com alta disponibilidade. Atuará com equipamentos como Cisco, Mitel, Avaya (ou equivalentes), sendo capaz de configurar e otimizar regras de sinalização (SIP) e fluxos de mídia (RTP), ajustar parâmetros de transporte TCP/UDP, implementar e gerenciar políticas de segurança para proteger contra ameaças como DoS/DDoS, fraude em chamadas e intercepções. Será responsável por assegurar a interoperabilidade entre diferentes protocolos e codecs, bem como a integração de SBC com outros componentes de rede e telecomunicações, como redes internas, operadoras externas, NATs, firewalls e VPNs. Deverá monitorar e otimizar a qualidade de serviço (QoS), latência, jitter, perda de pacotes, bem como realizar troubleshooting de incidentes, fazer auditorias de tráfego/comunicação, propor melhorias e atualizações, e garantir que os sistemas estejam alinhados com normas e compliance aplicáveis. Trabalhará colaborativamente com equipes de voz, redes, segurança e operações, influenciando decisões de arquitetura, definindo padrões de configuração, documentando processos e participando da sustentação contínua das operações


O que oferecemos:

  • Ambiente colaborativo e multicultural.
  • Oportunidade de desenvolvimento profissional em uma das líderes globais em tecnologia.
  • Pacote de benefícios completo CLT - PLR, VR, Previdência, Gympass, Convênio médico e Odonto e etc.

title: Clinical Site Manager
description:
Clinical Site Manager – (Ophthalmology & Neurology Focus)

Location: Remote-based


We’re partnering with a global biopharmaceutical company dedicated to advancing treatments in Ophthalmology, Neurology , and other complex therapeutic areas. To support several ongoing and upcoming studies, we are seeking a Clinical Site Manager to oversee key investigator sites across LATAM .

This position is offering a unique opportunity to blend operational oversight with strong relationship management at the site level.


Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary sponsor contact for assigned sites and CRO monitors, ensuring high-quality communication and collaboration.
  • Oversee site management activities across multiple studies, including start-up, monitoring, and close-out phases.
  • Drive patient recruitment and retention initiatives, fostering engagement with Principal Investigators and site coordinators.
  • Provide operational oversight of CRO CRAs to ensure adherence to protocol, timelines, and quality standards.
  • Support the sponsor’s clinical operations alignment , ensuring consistency and excellence in study execution.
  • Troubleshoot operational challenges and proactively address site-level issues to maintain study momentum.
  • Ensure proper management of study supplies, documentation, and compliance with GCP and sponsor SOPs.


Requirements

  • Proven experience as a Lead CRA , Senior CRA , or Clinical Site Manager with strong independent monitoring and site leadership skills.
  • Therapeutic experience in Ophthalmology and/or Neurology is essential.
  • Additional experience in Immunology, Rare Diseases, or Respiratory indications would be advantageous.
  • Solid understanding of GCP , ICH Guidelines , and regional regulatory requirements across Eastern Europe.
  • Excellent communication, relationship management, and problem-solving skills.
  • Willingness to travel across assigned countries as required.


Why Join?

  • Play a pivotal role in advancing innovative treatments that make a meaningful difference to patients’ lives.
  • Work in a hands-on, strategic role bridging sponsor oversight and site engagement.
  • Join an international, science-driven environment with opportunities for professional growth.



About Planet Pharma:


Planet Pharma is an American parented Employment Business/Agency that provides global staffing services with its head-quarters in Chicago and our EMEA regional office located in Central London. We have invested significantly in creating a robust international platform that enables us to work compliantly in 30+ countries with a current network of 2500+ active contractors globally as well as a very strong permanent / direct hire recruitment offering.


Our specialist knowledge and close relationships with our clients and the wider industry really makes us unique in our field. Just recently we were recognised by FORBES as the 17th best professional staffing firm, and have won multiple awards from industry accredited bodies for our commitment to excellence and service delivery. We have extensive functional expertise including: Regulatory Affairs, Pharmacovigilance, QA, QC, Submissions experts, Clinical development, Quality, Biostatistics, and Medical Affairs / Writing.


We are an equal opportunities Recruitment Business and Agency. We welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates regardless of their race, sex, disability, religion/belief, sexual orientation or age.

title: Business Developer PtX
description:
Leap29 are partnering with a leading international Independent Power Producer (IPP) entering Brazil’s renewable energy market. They are seeking a Business Developer to drive growth in Power-to-X (PtX) and green hydrogen projects. This is a remote role, but candidates must have a strong understanding of the Brazilian market, with established networks and local expertise to identify and develop new opportunities.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Conduct market, regulatory, and economic research to identify viable PtX and green hydrogen opportunities in Brazil.
  • Evaluate potential projects, sites, and partners during the screening phase.
  • Support early-stage project risk assessment and feasibility analysis.
  • Develop preliminary financial forecasts and investment models to guide strategic decisions.
  • Collaborate with internal and external teams to assess alignment with company goals.
  • Leverage existing networks to gather market intelligence and insights.


Key Requirements:

  • Proven experience in business development for PtX, green hydrogen or related derivatives.
  • Good knowledge of PtX, green hydrogen, and renewable energy markets in Brazil.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop and maintain relationships with local stakeholders in Brazil.
  • Ability to evaluate opportunities and conduct early-stage project analysis.
  • Strategic thinker with a proactive approach to identifying business opportunities.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish would be a plus)
  • Able to work remotely from Brazil, with occasional travel as needed.


Join a leading European IPP expanding into Brazil’s green hydrogen and PtX market. Leverage your local expertise, work with an international team, and help shape the future of renewable energy.


Ready to take on the challenge? Apply today!

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
DevOps Engineer


Are you looking to join a highly regarded IT development firm?


Look no further! WebCreek is hiring a DevOps Engineer with 3+ years of experience and a high level of English to work remotely from Latin America.


This role focuses on ensuring reliable, scalable, and secure infrastructure through automation, continuous integration, and deployment best practices. You’ll take the lead on optimizing cloud environments, improving CI/CD pipelines, and implementing monitoring and security strategies to support high-performance software delivery. In this fast-paced environment, your expertise will be key to driving efficiency, reliability, and continuous improvement across all development and operations processes.


What You'll Do

  • Manage and optimize Kubernetes clusters and containerized environments.
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions.
  • Deploy and manage infrastructure in Microsoft Azure using Terraform (IaC).
  • Automate processes with PowerShell, Bash, or similar scripting tools.
  • Ensure smooth integration between on-premises and cloud environments.
  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and improve system performance and reliability.
  • Collaborate with development and operations teams to enhance delivery pipelines.
  • Apply security and compliance best practices across systems and workflows.


What You Have

Required Skills:

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in DevOps or Cloud Infrastructure roles.
  • Experience working with Kubernetes and container orchestration in production environments.
  • Strong background in CI/CD automation using GitHub and GitHub Actions.
  • Proven experience with Microsoft Azure, including integration with on-premises infrastructure (hybrid environments).
  • Solid scripting skills in PowerShell, Bash, or equivalent languages.
  • Hands-on experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles.
  • A strong automation mindset, focused on simplifying workflows and reducing manual processes.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading projects and mentoring teams.
  • Advanced knowledge of Kubernetes deployment strategies.
  • Experience with Redis, Elasticsearch, or other distributed caching/search technologies.
  • Familiarity with messaging systems (RabbitMQ, Kafka, etc.).
  • Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform or Ansible.


What You'll Gain

  • A full-time position with long-term growth opportunities.
  • Competitive salary with regular performance-based reviews.
  • Access to top-tier benefits and professional development programs.
  • In-house IT training and industry-recognized certifications.
  • Flexible, remote-friendly work environment.
  • Health care expense sponsorship to support your well-being.
  • Fitness sponsorship to help you stay active and healthy.
  • Work with top global brands and industry-leading companies.
  • A collaborative international team with opportunities to work abroad.

WebCreek provides world- class software development teams and technical staff augmentation to Fortune 500 companies and other global industry leaders. With over 29 years of experience and a global presence spanning 20+ offices across North America, Latin America, Asia, and Europe, we deliver top-tier digital solutions to the companies that power the world.

title: Application Support Engineer – Salesforce & Azure (Specright / PDMS / Interius)
description:
We are seeking an Application Support Engineer to provide end-to-end technical and functional support for two enterprise platforms — Specright / PDMS (Salesforce-based) and Interius (Azure-hosted). This role will be responsible for ensuring smooth daily operations, resolving incidents, maintaining data integrity, and supporting integration enhancements across both systems.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Provide Tier 2/3 application support for the Specright PDMS and Interius platforms, managing incidents, service requests, and troubleshooting data and access issues.
  • Maintain and improve integrations between Salesforce-based and Azure-hosted systems; collaborate with middleware teams to configure, test, and monitor API and data connections.
  • Develop, modify, and troubleshoot Salesforce Data Loader scripts for bulk data imports, updates, and migrations.
  • Support supplier onboarding, user administration, and role-based access configuration.
  • Collaborate with business and IT teams to analyze issues, validate solutions, and optimize workflows.
  • Participate in integration testing, documentation of technical specifications, and maintenance of operational playbooks.
  • Liaise with vendor support teams (Salesforce, Specright) for escalated issues and platform enhancements.
  • Monitor system performance, identify improvement opportunities, and contribute to continuous process and system optimization.

Required Skills & Experience:

  • 5+ years of experience in enterprise SaaS application support (Salesforce preferred).
  • Hands-on experience with APIs (REST/SOAP) , authentication (OAuth/SSO), and data integration .
  • Experience with Salesforce Data Loader or similar ETL tools.
  • Exposure to Microsoft Azure environments and integration workflows.
  • Strong troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills; able to work independently in a global environment.
  • Experience supporting packaging, supplier, or product data management systems is a plus.

title: Scrum master
description:
Descrição da posição:

Buscamos um(a) profissional com sólida experiência em gestão de projetos de dados, com foco em estratégia de negócio e entrega de valor. Esta pessoa será responsável por liderar iniciativas de dados voltadas para um cliente do setor de saúde, garantindo que as soluções propostas estejam alinhadas com os objetivos estratégicos e operacionais do negócio.

O profissional atuará como ponte entre áreas técnicas e de negócio, promovendo a integração entre times de dados e stakeholders, e assegurando entregas com impacto real para o cliente.


Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Experiência comprovada em gestão de projetos de dados (Data Projects, Data Analytics, Data Engineering ou similares).
  • Vivência no setor de saúde (hospitalar, operadoras, clínicas, saúde suplementar ou pública).
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis e gestão de projetos (Scrum, Kanban, PMBOK, etc.).
  • Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções de dados.
  • Experiência em liderar times multidisciplinares de dados (engenheiros, analistas, cientistas de dados).


Requisitos desejáveis:

  • Certificações em gestão de projetos (PMP, PMI-ACP, CSM, etc.).
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de gestão de projetos (Jira, Trello, MS Project).
  • Familiaridade com plataformas de dados (AWS, Azure, GCP, Databricks).
  • Experiência com MLOps ou governança de dados.

title: Lead Full Stack Engineer
description:
Seniority : Lead

Location : Remote (LATAM preferred)

Contract Type : Full-time Contractor

Start Date : Early to mid-November 2025

Duration : 6 months (with the possibility of extension)

Schedule : Must be available between 9:00 AM and 1:00 PM EST


We’re looking for a Lead Fullstack Engineer to take technical ownership of two web-based products currently in development. This is a hands-on leadership role that blends architecture, coding, and collaboration. You’ll guide the project's direction, make key technical decisions, and ensure the delivery of reliable, scalable, and well-built software.


We’re looking for someone proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable working directly with product and design teams. You’ll be part of a small, talented group focused on building high-quality tools that make a real impact.


Responsibilities

  • Lead the technical design, implementation, and delivery of multiple web applications.
  • Work closely with product and design to turn requirements into well-structured, maintainable solutions.
  • Write clean, high-quality code using Node.js, React, and TypeScript.
  • Design and optimize databases using PostgreSQL.
  • Build and maintain scalable cloud infrastructure using AWS (ECS, EKS, S3, RDS).
  • Manage integrations with external platforms, including SSO and Okta.
  • Ensure performance, reliability, and security best practices are applied throughout the stack.
  • Support and mentor other developers, helping improve processes and code quality.


Requirements

  • Strong experience with Node.js, React, and TypeScript.
  • Deep understanding of PostgreSQL.
  • Proven experience deploying and maintaining applications on AWS (ECS, EKS, S3, RDS).
  • Comfortable with serverless architectures and microservices.
  • Experience integrating third-party tools and identity providers (SSO, Okta, etc.).
  • Excellent problem-solving and communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and make thoughtful technical decisions.
  • Advanced English


Nice to Have

  • Experience in the education technology sector or other large-scale, user-facing platforms.
  • Familiarity with Azure or Google Cloud.
  • Prior experience as a Tech Lead or Engineering Manager.
  • Strong eye for quality, UX, and performance.


Why Join

  • Lead the technical direction of growing products from an early stage.
  • Work in a fast-paced, fully remote environment with a high level of autonomy.
  • Collaborate with a passionate and professional team.

title: Network Operations Analyst (L1/L2 NOC – Early Shift) - LATAM
description:
SONDA is the largest IT service provider in Latin America, leader in systems integration, support and IT outsourcing. With almost 50 years of experience and in constant growth around the World, and growing so far in in US, as well.


We are looking for a Network Operations Analyst to join our client’s Early Shift team, providing first-line monitoring and coordination of network incidents across multiple retail locations. This professional will act as the main communication point between the client and the Managed Service Provider (MSP), ensuring timely updates, incident tracking, and clear communication with internal stakeholders.


Location: Nearshore (LATAM)

Work Schedule: Monday to Friday, from 5:00 AM to 12:00 PM ET

Model: Remote


Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor network events and incidents, escalating as needed (L1/L2 NOC equivalent).
  • Coordinate with the Managed Service Provider for updates and resolution progress.
  • Communicate incident status, impact, and resolution details to the Early Shift team.
  • Track, document, and report network incidents following established SLAs and procedures.
  • Support escalation and root cause analysis processes when required.
  • Maintain up-to-date records of communication, incident logs, and service documentation.


Requirements

  • Experience in Network Operations , NOC , or related technical support roles.
  • Basic understanding of network infrastructure (LAN/WAN, routers, switches, connectivity).
  • Familiarity with incident management and ticketing systems .
  • Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Excellent organizational and coordination abilities.
  • Availability to work from 5:00 AM to 12:00 PM ET (early shift).


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in retail network environments or with Managed Service Providers (MSPs) .
  • Exposure to network monitoring tools (e.g., SolarWinds, Zabbix, Nagios, PRTG).
  • Basic certifications such as CompTIA Network+ or CCNA are a plus.

title: Arquiteto SAP Commerce (Hybris)
description:
Arquiteto SAP Commerce (Hybris)

Local: 100% remoto

Regime: PJ ou Coop

Nível: Sênior / Especialista


Sobre a posição

Estamos em busca de um Arquiteto SAP Commerce (Hybris) experiente para atuar na definição e sustentação da arquitetura de soluções de e-commerce em ambiente SAP. O profissional será responsável por garantir o desempenho, escalabilidade e integração do SAP Commerce com demais sistemas corporativos, além de apoiar o time técnico em decisões de arquitetura e melhores práticas de desenvolvimento.

O papel requer forte base técnica, visão estratégica e experiência consolidada em projetos complexos de SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris , atuando de forma colaborativa com equipes de desenvolvimento, negócio e infraestrutura.


Responsabilidades

  • Definir e evoluir a arquitetura técnica e funcional das soluções baseadas em SAP Commerce (Hybris).
  • Garantir a integração eficiente do Commerce com SAP ERP / S/4HANA , SAP CPI e demais sistemas legados.
  • Apoiar o time de desenvolvimento na adoção de boas práticas de código, performance e segurança .
  • Conduzir análises de impacto, revisões técnicas e troubleshooting de alto nível.
  • Definir estratégias de deploy, versionamento e ambientes de homologação/produção .
  • Participar de reuniões técnicas e funcionais, apoiando o time de produto e negócios em decisões arquiteturais.
  • Atuar como referência técnica, orientando desenvolvedores e garantindo a aderência às diretrizes de arquitetura corporativa.


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência comprovada como Arquiteto ou Desenvolvedor Sênior SAP Commerce (Hybris) .
  • Sólido domínio em Java, Spring Framework e arquitetura RESTful .
  • Experiência com SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2) e/ou ambientes On-Premise.
  • Conhecimento em integrações com SAP ERP ou SAP S/4HANA , utilizando SAP CPI ou APIs customizadas.
  • Experiência em projetos de e-commerce B2B e B2C .
  • Vivência com ferramentas de versionamento (Git), automação (Jenkins, SonarQube) e metodologias ágeis.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com microservices , API management e arquiteturas em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP) .
  • Certificação SAP Commerce ou SAP Certified Development Professional – SAP Commerce Cloud.
  • Conhecimento em soluções de front-end (Angular, React) integradas ao SAP Commerce.
  • Experiência prévia em grandes ambientes corporativos ou projetos internacionais.

title: Regional Workforce Administration Manager
description:
Regional Workforce Administration Manager

Employment Type: Full Time Location: Brazil

Remote

Job Summary

Iron Mountain is seeking an experienced, strategic Regional Workforce Administration Manager to join our Workforce Administration (WFA) team. This person needs to be familiar with I-9 (Employment eligibility verification) and US Workforce processes asides from local Workforce Administration.

The ideal candidate must be strong in deploying inhouse strategies regarding employee files, benefit administration among others.

What You'll Do

In this role, you will:

  • Oversee all retained WFA services and, for regions outside of North America (NAM), manage Benefits Administration to ensure processes are properly documented, executed, and compliant with all local government regulations.
  • Drive continuous service delivery improvement by identifying opportunities, implementing solutions to enhance efficiency and accuracy, and collaborating with regional leaders on transformative projects (e.g., migrating administration work from other HR teams).

What You'll Bring

The ideal candidate will have:

  • 7+ years of proven experience in HR operations, HR Shared Services, or Workforce Administration, with a strong focus on a multi-country or international environment.
  • 2+ years of experience in people management, including leading, coaching, and managing the performance of direct reports.
  • In-depth knowledge of HR compliance requirements, employee data reporting, and Benefits Administration principles across Latam and North America.
  • Full professional proficiency in English and Spanish , along with demonstrated experience using HRIS systems like Workday and case management tools like ServiceNow (although others similar are ok)

  • Competitive compensation and benefits package.
  • Flexible work options/alternative work options to support work-life balance.
  • Comprehensive health, wellness, and retirement plans.
  • Opportunities for continuous learning and professional growth.

If you are a proven HR leader with deep expertise in workforce administration and a passion for driving operational excellence across diverse regions, apply to join Iron Mountain and lead our team today!

title: Senior ServiceNow Developer
description:
We are seeking a highly skilled Senior ServiceNow Developer with extensive ITOM experience to lead the development and enhancement of our ServiceNow platform. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in CMDB, Discovery, Integrations, and related ITOM modules. Must be able to work in fast-paced environment, often requiring collaboration with various teams and stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and implement complex ServiceNow ITOM solutions including CMDB, Discovery, and Service Mapping.
  • Experience with configuring and customizing ServiceNow applications and modules.
  • Lead development of integrations between ServiceNow and other enterprise systems.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Mentor junior developers and provide technical guidance.
  • Ensure best practices in coding, testing, and deployment.
  • Provide solutions that utilize most out of the box features without requiring customizations. Facilitate the reuse of code, components, and proven patterns; Influence common modeling, design, and coding practices.
  • Perform upgrade testing by validating customizations, configurations, and integrations across major and minor ServiceNow releases.
  • Develop and maintain Automated Test Framework (ATF) test suites to validate core ServiceNow functionalities, ensuring stability and reducing manual regression efforts.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve platform issues.
  • Maintain documentation for development and configuration.

Required Experience & Skills:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field.
  • 5-7 years of ServiceNow development experience with a focus on ITOM.
  • Strong knowledge of CMDB, CSDM, Discovery, Service Mapping, and Integrations.
  • Proficient in JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Glide API, REST/SOAP integrations, and ServiceNow scripting.
  • Experience with automation and DevOps practices, familiarity with continuous integration (CI/CD), code versioning tools such as Git, and Agile principles
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to establish strong relationships internally and externally.
  • Experience with Agile methodologies and DevOps practices.
  • Excellent problem-solving and communication skills.
  • Experience with AI, Virtual Agent, Robot Process Automation (RPA)



this position pays $25/hr USD

title: ServiceNow SPM Sr. Consultant / Functional Lead
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.


Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

— Conduzir a análise técnica do ambiente ServiceNow SPM , revisando arquitetura, integrações e fluxos de dados.

— Avaliar desempenho, segurança e aderência às boas práticas da plataforma, garantindo escalabilidade e sustentabilidade da solução.

— Mapear pontos de integração e revisar a escalabilidade técnica do ambiente.

— Identificar customizações existentes e avaliar o grau de aderência às funcionalidades nativas do ServiceNow.

— Avaliar prontidão para upgrade , riscos de compatibilidade e oportunidades de otimização.

— Recomendar ajustes técnicos, refactoring ou rollback quando necessário.

— Elaborar diagramas arquiteturais e documentação técnica detalhada.

— Apoiar o desenho de roadmaps técnicos e estratégias de melhoria contínua.

O que você precisa ter

— Mínimo de 8 anos de experiência com ServiceNow , incluindo participação em pelo menos 3 projetos SPM .

— Forte domínio técnico em arquitetura, integrações, performance e segurança .

— Experiência prática com CSDM, Flow Designer, Integration Hub e Performance Analytics .

— Certificação SPM-CIS fortemente desejável.

— CTA (Certified Technical Architect) ou CMA (Certified Master Architect) são diferenciais relevantes.

— Excelentes habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita em inglês e português.;

— Formação superior completa em Tecnologia da Informação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.

Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

— Conduzir a análise técnica do ambiente ServiceNow SPM , revisando arquitetura, integrações e fluxos de dados.

— Avaliar desempenho, segurança e aderência às boas práticas da plataforma, garantindo escalabilidade e sustentabilidade da solução.

— Mapear pontos de integração e revisar a escalabilidade técnica do ambiente.

— Identificar customizações existentes e avaliar o grau de aderência às funcionalidades nativas do ServiceNow.

— Avaliar prontidão para upgrade , riscos de compatibilidade e oportunidades de otimização.

— Recomendar ajustes técnicos, refactoring ou rollback quando necessário.

— Elaborar diagramas arquiteturais e documentação técnica detalhada.

— Apoiar o desenho de roadmaps técnicos e estratégias de melhoria contínua.

O que você precisa ter

— Mínimo de 8 anos de experiência com ServiceNow , incluindo participação em pelo menos 3 projetos SPM .

— Forte domínio técnico em arquitetura, integrações, performance e segurança .

— Experiência prática com CSDM, Flow Designer, Integration Hub e Performance Analytics .

— Certificação SPM-CIS fortemente desejável.

— CTA (Certified Technical Architect) ou CMA (Certified Master Architect) são diferenciais relevantes.

— Excelentes habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita em inglês e português.;

— Formação superior completa em Tecnologia da Informação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.

At Eracore , we bring innovation and precision to the forefront of electrical construction through advanced BIM modeling. From coordination and prefabrication to detailed shop drawings, we support some of the most complex and high-stakes electrical projects in the United States including Data Centers, Government Facilities, Manufacturing Plants, and cutting-edge Commercial developments.

Role Description

This is a full-time remote role for a BIM/VDC Specialist at Eracore . title: DevOps Engineer - AWS
description:
Job Title: DevOps Engineer (AWS Specialist)

Location: Remote (Must be based in Brazil)

Job Type: Full-Time, Permanent

Salary: $4000-6,000 per month (Depending on experience)


IF APPLYING, SEND CV IN ENGLISH


About the Role

We are seeking an experienced and motivated DevOps Engineer with strong expertise in Amazon Web Services (AWS) and a solid background in Windows-based infrastructure .

As a member of our global DevOps and infrastructure team, you will be involved in designing, building, and maintaining modern cloud platforms and automation pipelines that support our mission-critical systems.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain AWS infrastructure using Terraform and other Infrastructure as Code tools.
  • Support and manage Windows-based systems including Active Directory , domain configuration , and Entra ID .
  • Implement security controls, tools, and processes aligned with best practices in cloud and infrastructure security .
  • Provide support across Windows systems as required (Linux knowledge is a plus).
  • Manage and scale containerized applications using Kubernetes .
  • Set up and manage monitoring and alerting with tools such as Prometheus and Grafana .
  • Collaborate with engineering, security, and operations teams to deliver reliable and secure infrastructure solutions.
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipeline development and automation workflows.


Key Requirements

Must-Have Skills & Experience

  • Proven experience working with AWS in production environments.
  • Strong Windows Server experience, including Active Directory , domain setup , and Entra ID .
  • Working knowledge of infrastructure security best practices .
  • Practical experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code methodologies.
  • Experience with Kubernetes for container orchestration.
  • Expereince with Ansible
  • Familiarity with monitoring/observability using Grafana , Prometheus , or similar.
  • Fluent English communication skills .
  • Must be permanently based in Ireland and eligible to work without sponsorship.


Nice-to-Have

  • Experience with Linux system administration.
  • Exposure to CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI).
  • Scripting skills (e.g., PowerShell, Bash, Python).


What We Offer

  • Fully remote role , but you must reside in Brazil
  • Permanent employment with long-term project engagement and career progression.
  • Dynamic, international team working on cutting-edge cloud and DevOps technologies.
  • Opportunities for professional development and training.

title: Cloud Native Developer
description:
QAT Global, a US-based IT consulting firm with over 30 years of experience, is looking for a Senior Cloud Native Developer to join our growing team. We are proud to deliver world-class technology solutions with teams across the US, Costa Rica, and Brazil.

This is a full-time, remote position (CLT hire in Brazil only), offering the opportunity to collaborate directly with our US-based client and international development teams.


About the role:


As a Senior Cloud Native Developer , you will play a key role in designing, building, and maintaining scalable, cloud-native applications using Azure and .NET technologies . You will collaborate with product owners, architects, and cross-functional teams to implement high-quality software solutions that follow modern engineering practices.

This role is ideal for someone with deep technical expertise in Azure cloud services , microservices , and backend development , combined with strong problem-solving abilities and a collaborative mindset.


Responsibilities:


  • Design, develop, and maintain cloud-native applications using Azure services , .NET Core , and C# .
  • Implement and manage CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions to ensure smooth and automated deployments.
  • Define and manage infrastructure as code (IaC) using Pulumi .
  • Develop microservices and event-driven architectures leveraging Azure Functions , Azure Service Bus , and Cosmos DB .
  • Build and optimize RESTful APIs , ensuring scalability, security, and maintainability.
  • Collaborate closely with architects, QA, and product teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Apply best practices for monitoring , logging , and application performance management .
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.


Required Qualifications:


  • Strong experience in software development with .NET Core and C# .
  • Strong knowledge of Azure cloud services , including Azure Functions , Service Bus , and Cosmos DB .
  • Experience with microservices architecture and event-driven systems .
  • Solid understanding of CI/CD concepts , including hands-on experience with GitHub Actions or similar tools.
  • Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Pulumi , Terraform , or similar frameworks.
  • Experience building and managing containers (Docker) and working with container orchestration platforms (Kubernetes).
  • Strong understanding of software design principles , clean code , and best engineering practices .
  • Excellent communication skills in English and ability to work collaboratively in distributed, cross-functional teams.


Preferred Qualifications (Nice to Have):


  • Experience with Kafka or similar event streaming platforms.
  • Familiarity with Application Insights , Grafana , or other monitoring tools.
  • Understanding of MuleSoft or similar integration platforms.
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
